recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-14726 unless the Vocabulary work group separately chooses to revise broader introductory prose.
issue_request: FHIR-14726 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocabulary technical correction asking to replace an incorrect ValueSet-like CodeSystem definition. The final accepted wording says the CodeSystem resource declares and describes a code system or code system supplement, key properties, and optionally part or all of its content.
initial_application: The change was historically applied by git-svn commit 04bb1e9d0e8a53fc60f7bb808e88ff75dbb12f3a, svn revision 13150, with subject 'GF#14726 - Fix CodeSystem resource definition.' The 2021 source rework carried that wording into source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml.
additional_context: The linked Zulip #terminology thread confirms GF#14726 as a copy/paste error and records the final wording. FHIR-13450 and FHIR-14242 are duplicate reports of the same incorrect definition. Later FHIR-39044 clarified surrounding Scope and Usage prose without superseding the FHIR-14726 resource definition.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. CodeSystem is active in source/fhir.ini, the authoritative StructureDefinition description and root definition already contain the accepted wording, terminology-module.html uses the same wording for the resource list, and the old incorrect CodeSystem sentence is absent from current CodeSystem source.
